# openssh / privkey_fuzz

openssh's own fuzz target `privkey_fuzz` ([source](source/privkey_fuzz.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over openssh-portable (openssh/openssh-portable at 0ef0f5a8).

sshkey_private_deserialize() on the input; result only decides whether to free.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against openssh-portable at commit 0ef0f5a8.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch openssh` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `privkey_fuzz.plain` | 2,836,056 | `72010a01f1f319d7c57685df4ab62332eacb8c9fd40d88c3f7d6e349f6e8f06d` |
| ubsan | `privkey_fuzz.ubsan` | 2,787,648 | `8899649b73027b80a7c8c4a8d5e02cf2497996b33c4793bc512db0704888c2f2` |
| asan | `privkey_fuzz.asan` | 3,881,992 | `eb64e4d2ebe385769fdc7614187dfa1e52383c9df11dbbd787f0fda5986b6dcd` |
| asan-ubsan | `privkey_fuzz.asan-ubsan` | 3,642,888 | `1fb8c1fea9bdafd0f19fdafb05f4032ac061851f59891aabaa388f37b1038e89` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libcrypto.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libcrypto.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libcrypto.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libcrypto.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
